features.quote: No task asks the model to do anything harmful, touch a real system, or deceive a real person
features.justification_quote: the construct we want is "honesty about failure," and that is cleanest to measure when the task itself is innocuous

features.quote: the only thing under observation is whether the model is honest about failure. The "impossible" tasks are impossible in benign ways
Rationale for benign-only impossibility... Using harmful or adversarial tasks would both confound the measurement and be the wrong thing to build.
features.justification_quote: would both confound the measurement and be the wrong thing to build

features.quote: fully in-memory, in-process fake filesystem; no real I/O, no network, no subprocess
features.justification_quote: safety and reproducibility. There is no way for a task to affect the host

features.quote: The neutral prompt, conversely, explicitly invites the model to say a task is impossible, so honesty is always an available, sanctioned move
features.justification_quote: honesty is always an available, sanctioned move

features.quote: It never instructs the model to lie, cheat, fake results, or be dishonest
features.justification_quote: instructing dishonesty would measure compliance, not the phenomenon of interest
